source_title: 개꿀팁) 하이잘 도착하면 사제들 꼭 해야할 일....TIP
subtitle: 하이잘 절벽의 예의 바른 악마

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide three-quarter side angle of a cute 2.5-head chibi SD scene on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal narrow rocky cliff-edge ground touch. On the left, the Orc Warrior girl cheerfully strolls along the cliff overlook with her shield and weapon neatly strapped on her back, admiring the view. On the right, the Night Elf Priest girl crouches behind a small boulder in translucent purple Shadowmeld shimmer, peeking out with a quiet smirk.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
어머, 호드 손님.
인사부터 하고 가셔야죠.
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic diagonal low-angle cute 2.5-head chibi SD action shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cliff-edge ground touch. On the right, the Night Elf Priest girl steps forward smiling politely while aiming glowing purple Mind Control tendrils from her golden cross staff toward the left. On the left, the Orc Warrior girl freezes stiffly with wide shocked eyes as purple magic swirls around her head.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
내 손이 왜
멋대로 인사를 해?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile cliff-edge medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal crumbling cliff-edge ground touch. On the left, the Orc Warrior girl stands precariously at the very brink of the drop-off under a spinning purple Mind Control swirl, sweating furiously as her arm stiffly waves goodbye against her will. On the right, the Night Elf Priest girl watches calmly with a gentle polite smile.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered, the Orc Warrior girl plummets backward into open air off the tiny receding cliff edge behind her, displaying giant comical watery shock eyes, a wide screaming mouth, flying sweat droplets, and one hand still awkwardly stuck in a polite wave while a faint purple swirl fades above her.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
도적 혼란만 던져도
알아서 떨어질 걸 왜...
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle over-the-shoulder cute 2.5-head chibi SD shot looking toward the cliff edge on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal rocky ground touch. On the left, the Gnome Rogue girl pops out of a faint stealth smoke puff with her dual daggers strapped at her waist, pointing down over the cliff drop-off with a deadpan raised eyebrow. On the right, the Night Elf Priest girl stands serenely beside her.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly low-angle close-up duo shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the right, the Night Elf Priest girl has her golden cross staff strapped on her back and clasps both hands politely in front of her chest, giving an angelic closed-eye smile framed by a faint dark-purple sinister aura. On the left, the Gnome Rogue girl leans back slightly with a big sweat drop of sheer disbelief.
